credits.title: LifeLike
credits.overview: For the terminally ill Izzet, time is nearly up. Doctors have given up, prayers and rituals offer little help, and his family's future is now in God's hands. So Izzet spends his time in virtual reality, roaming through the astonishing and otherworldly places of the virtual cosmos. He even meets his girlfriend there…

credits.title: Hazirun
credits.overview: In the early morning following a night shaken by citywide protests, Ali, a man in his twenties, is awakened by police sirens and forced to act as a “Hazirun” during a search of a neighboring apartment. credits.title: Crystal of Happiness
credits.overview: After the death of her husband, Şerife intends to live out her seventies as she sees fit. But her children, annoyed by her new behavior and friends, try to bring her back into line.

credits.title: Stone and Feather
credits.overview: Nazire, in order to take back her child who was sent to an orphanage, puts up a tough fight against both the bureaucratic system that offers her child conditions she cannot overcome, and the rich foster family who wants to adopt her child.

credits.title: Love At Last
credits.overview: The funny story of Aslı, an advertising executive who doesn't want to be alone on Valentine's Day.

credits.title: Nothing in Its Place
credits.overview: In 1978, five leftist youths who believed that the leftist revolution could be realized through politics, not violence, gathered in a house and started to talk about the magazine they had published. The unexpected events that take place later that night reveal the political chaos in Turkey before the 1980 coup d'état.

credits.title: Hi Mom, It’s Me, Lou Lou
credits.overview: After his mother's death, Hakki, who has hidden his homosexuality from all other family members except his mother, must confront the life he left behind when he returns to the family home he hasn't visited for many years.

credits.title: Glass Curtain
credits.overview: Nesrin, a single mother who lives with her four-year-old son, struggles with her ex-husband Ömer’s oppressive behaviour and bureaucratic hardships while she is on the brink of making a critical decision regarding her relationship with her boyfriend Selim.

credits.title: A Matter of Prestige
credits.overview: The film, which deals with the birth and rise of the Prestige Music generation, tells the passions and life struggles of artists, including Özcan Deniz, Haluk Levent and Mahsun Kırmızıgül, from the 1990s to the present.
